name: auto_review_candidates
description: Run conservative heuristic auto-review across pending memory entries and rule candidates. Returns the standard summary shape (auto_confirmed / auto_rejected / kept_pending / needs_user_confirmation). Public MCP always keeps this tool preview-only; durable changes go through explicit confirm/reject tools.

apply.description: When true, apply auto_confirm / auto_reject decisions. When false (default), preview without writes.
